    func parentUpdateFixture(t testing.TB, threeLeaves bool) (*Database, string, *leafLocation, *leafSplitPlan) {
    	t.Helper()
    	db, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, 7, traversalPages(t))
    	location, err := db.findLeaf([]byte("ant"))
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	if threeLeaves {
    		location.leaf.Put([]byte("ant"), make([]byte, 1993))
    		location.leaf.Put([]byte("bat"), make([]byte, 2993))
    		location.leaf.Put([]byte("bee"), make([]byte, 1993))
    	} else {
    		location.leaf.Put([]byte("ant"), make([]byte, 2000))
    		location.leaf.Put([]byte("bee"), make([]byte, 2084))
    	}
    	plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	return db, path, location, plan
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_PreservesSiblingsAndSelectsImmediateParent(t *testing.T) {
    	cases := []struct {
    		name, first, second string
    		parentID uint64
    		keys []string
    		children []uint64
    	}{
    		{"LeftChildOfLeftParent", "ant", "bee", 5, []string{"bee", "cat"}, []uint64{1, 8, 2}},
    		{"RightChildOfLeftParent", "cat", "catalog", 5, []string{"cat", "catalog"}, []uint64{1, 2, 8}},
    		{"LeftChildOfRightParent", "dog", "fox", 6, []string{"fox", "yak"}, []uint64{3, 8, 4}},
    		{"RightChildOfRightParent", "yak", "zebra", 6, []string{"yak", "zebra"}, []uint64{3, 4, 8}},
    	}
    	for _, tc := range cases {
    		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
    			db, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, 7, traversalPages(t))
    			location, err := db.findLeaf([]byte(tc.first))
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			location.leaf.Put([]byte(tc.first), make([]byte, 2000))
    			location.leaf.Put([]byte(tc.second), make([]byte, 2084))
    			plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			require.Len(t, plan.pages, 2)
    			before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			headerBefore := *db.header
    			pagesBefore := bytes.Join(plan.pages, nil)
    			parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			assert.Equal(t, tc.parentID, parentID)
    			assert.Equal(t, traversalInternalPage(t, tc.keys, tc.children), page)
    			parent, err := pager.DecodeInternal(page)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			assert.Equal(t, location.pageID, parent.ChildFor([]byte(tc.first)))
    			assert.Equal(t, uint64(8), parent.ChildFor([]byte(tc.second)))
    			assert.Equal(t, []uint64{7, tc.parentID}, location.parents)
    			assert.Equal(t, [][]byte{[]byte(tc.second)}, plan.separators)
    			assert.Equal(t, pagesBefore, bytes.Join(plan.pages, nil))
    			assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
    			assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    		})
    	}
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_AddsMultipleChildren(t *testing.T) {
    	db, path, location, plan := parentUpdateFixture(t, true)
    	require.Len(t, plan.pages, 3)
    	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	assert.Equal(t, uint64(5), parentID)
    	assert.Equal(t, traversalInternalPage(t, []string{"bat", "bee", "cat"}, []uint64{1, 8, 9, 2}), page)
    	assert.Equal(t, uint64(8), db.header.PageCount)
    	assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    	page[0] = 0xff
    	_, again, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	assert.Equal(t, byte(pager.PageTypeInternal), again[0])
    	assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_RejectsInvalidInputWithoutWriting(t *testing.T) {
    	cases := []struct {
    		name string
    		change func(*leafLocation, *leafSplitPlan)
    		want error
    	}{
    		{"NoParent", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { l.parents = nil }, nil},
    		{"NoPages", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { p.pages = nil }, nil},
    		{"OnePage", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { p.pages = p.pages[:1] }, nil},
    		{"MissingSeparators", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { p.separators = nil }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"TooManySeparators", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { p.separators = append(p.separators, []byte("bob")) }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"SeparatorOutsideChildRange", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { p.separators[0] = []byte("zebra") }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"ChildNotInParent", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { l.pageID = 4 }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"ParentIsLeaf", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { l.parents = []uint64{7, 1} }, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage},
    		{"MissingParentPage", func(l *leafLocation, p *leafSplitPlan) { l.parents = []uint64{7, 8} }, io.EOF},
    	}
    	for _, tc := range cases {
    		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
    			db, path, location, plan := parentUpdateFixture(t, false)
    			tc.change(location, plan)
    			before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			headerBefore := *db.header
    			parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
    			require.Error(t, err)
    			if tc.want != nil {
    				require.ErrorIs(t, err, tc.want)
    			}
    			assert.Zero(t, parentID)
    			assert.Nil(t, page)
    			assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
    			assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    		})
    	}
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_RejectsFullParentBeforeWriting(t *testing.T) {
    	separator := string(bytes.Repeat([]byte{'z'}, 3000))
    	pages := [][]byte{
    		traversalLeafPage(t, "a"),
    		traversalLeafPage(t),
    		traversalInternalPage(t, []string{separator}, []uint64{1, 2}),
    	}

    	location, err := db.findLeaf([]byte("a"))
    	require.NoError(t, err)

    	plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	require.Len(t, plan.pages, 2)
    	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	headerBefore := *db.header
    	parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
    	require.ErrorIs(t, err, pager.ErrPagerPageFull)

    	assert.Nil(t, page)
    	assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
    	assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    }

Suppose:

    func (db *Database) Put(key, value []byte) error {
        location, err := db.findLeaf(key)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("find leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        location.leaf.Put(key, value)
    
        updatedLeaf, err := pager.EncodeLeaf(location.leaf)
        if errors.Is(err, pager.ErrPagerPageFull) {
            if location.pageID == db.header.RootPageID {
                return db.splitRootLeaf(location.leaf)
            }
    
            return db.splitNonRootLeaf(location)
        }
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("encode updated leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(location.pageID, updatedLeaf); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write updated leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("sync database: %w", err)
        }
    
        return nil
    }

The important difference from your leaf split: **when an internal key doesn’t fit, promote it to the parent and leave it out of both resulting nodes.**

For example, suppose `dog` is the first key that doesn’t fit:

```text
Original:
keys:      [cat, dog, yak]
children:  [ 1,   2,   3,   4 ]

Left node:             Promoted:       Right node:
keys:     [cat]        dog             keys:     [yak]
children: [1, 2]                       children: [3, 4]
```

The actual decision uses byte sizes; these short example keys would fit on one page.

Follow these steps:

1. **Fix your starting capacity and collect promoted keys.**

   ```go
   remainingSpace := pagerByteSize - internalHeaderSize
   var separators [][]byte
   ```

   The internal header already includes space for the first child pointer.

2. **Inside the loop, calculate each entry’s size.**

   ```go
   entrySize := internalEntryHeaderSize + len(n.keys[i])
   ```

   That covers the key length, key bytes, and its right child pointer.

3. **When the entry doesn’t fit, finish the current node.**

   Use these slices with `NewBPlusInternal`:

   ```go
   n.keys[start:i]
   n.children[start : i+1]
   ```

   The key at `i` is excluded. The children slice contains one more element than the keys slice, as required.

   Handle the constructor error, then append the node to `internals`.

4. **Promote the key and begin the next group.**

   ```go
   separators = append(separators, slices.Clone(n.keys[i]))
   start = i + 1
   remainingSpace = pagerByteSize - internalHeaderSize
   continue
   ```

   The `continue` matters: this key belongs to the parent, so it consumes no space in the next node.

   For entries that **do fit**, subtract `entrySize` from `remainingSpace`.

5. **After the loop, create the final node.**

   Its slices are:

   ```go
   n.keys[start:]
   n.children[start:]
   ```

   Handle the error and append it to `internals`. Then return:

   ```go
   return internals, separators, nil
   ```

    package pager
    
    import (
        "bytes"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
    )
    
    func ValidateLeaf(leaf *BPlusLeaf) error {
        if leaf == nil {
            return errors.New("leaf is nil")
        }
    
        if err := validateLeafEntries(leaf.keys, leaf.values); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    
        for i := range leaf.keys {
            if len(leaf.keys[i]) > maxKeySize {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: key exceeds maximum payload size: %w", i, ErrPagerEntryTooLarge)
            }
    
            if len(leaf.values[i]) > maxEntryPayload-len(leaf.keys[i]) {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: key and value exceed page capacity: %w", i, ErrPagerEntryTooLarge)
            }
        }
    
        remainingSpace := pagerByteSize - leafHeaderSize
        for i := range leaf.keys {
            if remainingSpace < leafEntryHeaderSize {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: not enough space for entry header: %w", i, ErrPagerPageFull)
            }
            remainingSpace -= leafEntryHeaderSize
    
            if remainingSpace < len(leaf.keys[i]) {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: key does not fit: %w", i, ErrPagerPageFull)
            }
            remainingSpace -= len(leaf.keys[i])
    
            if remainingSpace < len(leaf.values[i]) {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: value does not fit: %w", i, ErrPagerPageFull)
            }
            remainingSpace -= len(leaf.values[i])
        }
    
        return nil
    }
    
    func validateLeafEntries(keys, values [][]byte) error {
        if len(keys) != len(values) {
            return errors.New("keys and values must be the same length")
        }
    
        return validateKeyOrder(keys)
    }
    
    func ValidateHeader(header *DatabaseHeader) error {
        if header == nil {
            return errors.New("header is nil")
        }
    
        if header.FormatVersion != currentFormatVersion {
            return fmt.Errorf("unsupported database version: %d should be: %d", header.FormatVersion, currentFormatVersion)
        }
    
        if header.PageSize != pagerByteSize {
            return fmt.Errorf("unsupported page size: %d should be: %d", header.PageSize, pagerByteSize)
        }
    
        if header.PageCount < 2 {
            return errors.New("page count must be at least 2")
        }
    
        if header.PageCount > maxPageID+1 {
            return fmt.Errorf("page count must not exceed %d", maxPageID+1)
        }
    
        if header.RootPageID == 0 || header.RootPageID >= header.PageCount {
            return fmt.Errorf("root page ID must be between 1 and %d", header.PageCount-1)
        }
    
        return nil
    }
    
    func validateKeyOrder(keys [][]byte) error {
        for i := 1; i < len(keys); i++ {
            if bytes.Compare(keys[i], keys[i-1]) <= 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("keys must be sorted in strictly ascending order: %w", ErrPagerInvalidArgument)
            }
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func validateInternalEntries(keys [][]byte, children []uint64) error {
        if len(children) != len(keys)+1 {
            return ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode
        }
    
        if err := validateKeyOrder(keys); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    
        seen := make(map[uint64]struct{}, len(children))
        for i := range children {
            if _, exists := seen[children[i]]; exists {
                return ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode
            }
            seen[children[i]] = struct{}{}
    
            if children[i] > maxPageID || children[i] == 0 {
                return ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode
            }
        }
    
        return nil
    }
    
    func ValidateInternal(internal *BPlusInternal) error {
        if internal == nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("internal node is nil: %w", ErrPagerInvalidArgument)
        }
    
        if err := validateInternalEntries(internal.keys, internal.children); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    
        for i := range internal.keys {
            if len(internal.keys[i]) > maxKeySize {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: key exceeds maximum payload size: %w", i, ErrPagerEntryTooLarge)
            }
        }
    
        remainingSpace := pagerByteSize - internalHeaderSize
        for i := range internal.keys {
            remainingSpace -= internalEntryHeaderSize + len(internal.keys[i])
            if remainingSpace < 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("entry %d: not enough space for entry: %w", i, ErrPagerPageFull)
            }
        }
    
        return nil
    }

            {"Last", 7, byteStrings("z"), []uint64{9}, byteStrings("m", "t", "z"), []uint64{8, 2, 7, 9}},
            {"FirstMultiple", 8, byteStrings("c", "h"), []uint64{9, 10}, byteStrings("c", "h", "m", "t"), []uint64{8, 9, 10, 2, 7}},

    package database
    
    import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
    
        "github.com/Noah-Wilderom/godb/pkg/pager"
    )
    
    type leafSplitPlan struct {
        pages      [][]byte
        separators [][]byte
    }
    
    type rootSplitPlan struct {
        leafPages  [][]byte
        rootPage   []byte
        headerPage []byte
        header     pager.DatabaseHeader
    }
    
    func prepareLeafSplit(leaf *pager.BPlusLeaf) (*leafSplitPlan, error) {
        leaves, err := leaf.Split()
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        plan := &leafSplitPlan{
            pages:      make([][]byte, len(leaves)),
            separators: make([][]byte, len(leaves)-1),
        }
    
        for idx, leaf := range leaves {
            page, err := pager.EncodeLeaf(leaf)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, err
            }
    
            plan.pages[idx] = page
    
            if idx > 0 {
                firstKey, hasFirstKey := leaf.FirstKey()
                if !hasFirstKey {
                    return nil, fmt.Errorf("leaf %d has no first key: %w", idx, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
                }
    
                plan.separators[idx-1] = firstKey
            }
        }
    
        return plan, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) prepareRootLeafSplit(leaf *pager.BPlusLeaf) (*rootSplitPlan, error) {
        plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("prepare leaf split: %w", err)
        }
    
        if len(plan.pages) < 2 {
            return nil, errors.New("there's no need to create a new root for a leaf that already fits")
        }
    
        n := uint64(len(plan.pages))
        nextHeader := *db.header
        nextHeader.RootPageID = db.header.PageCount + n - 1
        nextHeader.PageCount = db.header.PageCount + n
    
        headerBytes, err := pager.EncodeHeader(&nextHeader)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode new header: %w", err)
        }
    
        childPageIDS := make([]uint64, n)
        childPageIDS[0] = db.header.RootPageID
        for i := 1; i < len(childPageIDS); i++ {
            childPageIDS[i] = db.header.PageCount + uint64(i-1)
        }
    
        root, err := pager.NewBPlusInternal(plan.separators, childPageIDS)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("create new root: %w", err)
        }
    
        rootBytes, err := pager.EncodeInternal(root)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode new root: %w", err)
        }
    
        return &rootSplitPlan{
            leafPages:  plan.pages,
            rootPage:   rootBytes,
            headerPage: headerBytes,
            header:     nextHeader,
        }, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) splitRootLeaf(leaf *pager.BPlusLeaf) error {
        plan, err := db.prepareRootLeafSplit(leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("prepare root leaf split: %w", err)
        }
    
        fileSize, err := db.pager.GetFileSize()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("get file size: %w", err)
        }
    
        if fileSize != db.header.PageCount*uint64(db.header.PageSize) {
            return fmt.Errorf("file size %d does not match header page count %d and page size %d: %w", fileSize, db.header.PageCount, db.header.PageSize, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
        }
    
        for i := 1; i < len(plan.leafPages); i++ {
            pageID, err := db.pager.AppendPage(plan.leafPages[i])
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("append leaf page %d: %w", i, err)
            }
    
            if pageID != db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1) {
                return fmt.Errorf("appended leaf page %d has unexpected page ID %d, expected %d: %w", i, pageID, db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1), pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
            }
        }
    
        rootPageID, err := db.pager.AppendPage(plan.rootPage)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("append root page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if rootPageID != plan.header.RootPageID {
            return fmt.Errorf("appended root page has unexpected page ID %d, expected %d: %w", rootPageID, plan.header.RootPageID, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(db.header.RootPageID, plan.leafPages[0]); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write first leaf page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(0, plan.headerPage); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write new header page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("flush pager: %w", err)
        }
    
        db.header = &plan.header
        return nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) prepareParentUpdate(location *leafLocation, plan *leafSplitPlan) (uint64, []byte, error) {
        if len(location.parents) < 1 || len(plan.pages) < 2 {
            return 0, nil, errors.New("cannot prepare parent update for a leaf with no parents or a split plan with less than 2 pages")
        }
    
        parentID := location.parents[len(location.parents)-1]
        parentPage, err := db.pager.ReadPage(parentID)
        if err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("read parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        parent, err := pager.DecodeInternal(parentPage)
        if err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("decode parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        rightChildren := make([]uint64, len(plan.pages)-1)
        for i := range rightChildren {
            rightChildren[i] = db.header.PageCount + uint64(i)
        }
    
        if err := parent.InsertSplit(location.pageID, plan.separators, rightChildren); err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("insert split into parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        updatedParentPage, err := pager.EncodeInternal(parent)
        if err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("encode updated parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        return parentID, updatedParentPage, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) splitNonRootLeaf(location *leafLocation) error {
        plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("prepare leaf split: %w", err)
        }
    
        parentID, updatedParentPage, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("prepare parent update: %w", err)
        }
    
        nextHeader := *db.header
        nextHeader.PageCount += uint64(len(plan.pages) - 1)
    
        headerBytes, err := pager.EncodeHeader(&nextHeader)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("encode new header: %w", err)
        }
    
        fileSize, err := db.pager.GetFileSize()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("get file size: %w", err)
        }
    
        if fileSize != db.header.PageCount*uint64(db.header.PageSize) {
            return fmt.Errorf("file size %d does not match header page count %d and page size %d: %w", fileSize, db.header.PageCount, db.header.PageSize, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
        }
    
        for i := 1; i < len(plan.pages); i++ {
            pageID, err := db.pager.AppendPage(plan.pages[i])
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("append leaf page %d: %w", i, err)
            }
    
            if pageID != db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1) {
                return fmt.Errorf("appended leaf page %d has unexpected page ID %d, expected %d: %w", i, pageID, db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1), pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
            }
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(location.pageID, plan.pages[0]); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write first leaf page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(parentID, updatedParentPage); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write updated parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(0, headerBytes); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write new header page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("flush pager: %w", err)
        }
    
        db.header = &nextHeader
        return nil
    }

Almost—your final node is now included, but **`slices.Clone(n.keys[start:])` only copies the outer slice**. The individual key bytes remain shared with the original node.

That means changing:

```go
internals[len(internals)-1].keys[0][0] = 'x'
```

would also change the corresponding key in `n`.

Replace your final `append` block with the constructor you already use inside the loop:

```go
internal, err := NewBPlusInternal(n.keys[start:], n.children[start:])
if err != nil {
	return nil, nil, err
}

internals = append(internals, internal)
```

`NewBPlusInternal` copies every key’s bytes, so all returned nodes own their data. Your `children` clone was fine because its elements are plain `uint64` values.

After this correction, we can add tests and benchmarks, then prepare encoded internal splits for the database layer.

    package pager
    
    import (
    	"bytes"
    	"testing"
    
    	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
    	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
    )
    
    func internalSplitFixture(t testing.TB, sizes []int) *BPlusInternal {
    	t.Helper()
    	keys := make([][]byte, len(sizes))
    	children := make([]uint64, len(sizes)+1)
    	for i, size := range sizes {
    		keys[i] = bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte('a' + i)}, size)
    	}
    	for i := range children {
    		children[i] = uint64(100 + i)
    	}
    	node, err := NewBPlusInternal(keys, children)
    	require.NoError(t, err)
    	return node
    }
    
    func TestBPlusInternal_Split(t *testing.T) {
    	cases := []struct {
    		name     string
    		sizes    []int
    		promoted []int
    	}{
    		{"SingleChild", nil, nil},
    		{"AlreadyFits", []int{3, 4, 5}, nil},
    		{"EmptyKey", []int{0, 3}, nil},
    		{"ExactFit", []int{2000, 2065}, nil},
    		{"MaximumKey", []int{4075}, nil},
    		{"OneByteOverflow", []int{2000, 2066}, []int{1}},
    		{"TwoNodes", []int{2000, 2100, 100}, []int{1}},
    		{"ThreeNodes", []int{3000, 3000, 3000, 3000, 3000}, []int{1, 3}},
    		{"FinalSingleChild", []int{4075, 4075, 4075, 4075}, []int{1, 3}},
    		{"PromotedKeyConsumesNoSpace", []int{3000, 3000, 2000, 2000}, []int{1}},
    	}
    	for _, tc := range cases {
    		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
    			node := internalSplitFixture(t, tc.sizes)
    			before, err := NewBPlusInternal(node.keys, node.children)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			nodes, separators, err := node.Split()
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			require.Len(t, nodes, len(tc.promoted)+1)
    			require.Len(t, separators, len(tc.promoted))
    			assert.Equal(t, before, node)
    
    			start := 0
    			parentChildren := make([]uint64, len(nodes))
    			for i, part := range nodes {
    				end := len(node.keys)
    				if i < len(tc.promoted) {
    					end = tc.promoted[i]
    					assert.Equal(t, node.keys[end], separators[i])
    				}
    				assert.Equal(t, node.keys[start:end], part.keys)
    				assert.Equal(t, node.children[start:end+1], part.children)
    				require.NoError(t, ValidateInternal(part))
    				page, err := EncodeInternal(part)
    				require.NoError(t, err)
    				decoded, err := DecodeInternal(page)
    				require.NoError(t, err)
    				assert.Equal(t, part, decoded)
    				parentChildren[i] = uint64(i + 1)
    				start = end + 1
    			}
    
    			parent, err := NewBPlusInternal(separators, parentChildren)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			queries := [][]byte{nil, {0xff}}
    			for _, key := range node.keys {
    				queries = append(queries, key, append(bytes.Clone(key), 0))
    			}
    			for i, query := range queries {
    				part := nodes[parent.ChildFor(query)-1]
    				assert.Equal(t, node.ChildFor(query), part.ChildFor(query), "query %d", i)
    			}
    		})
    	}
    }
    
    func TestBPlusInternal_SplitOwnsData(t *testing.T) {
    	for _, sizes := range [][]int{{3, 4}, {3000, 3000, 3000, 3000, 3000}} {
    		node := internalSplitFixture(t, sizes)
    		before, err := NewBPlusInternal(node.keys, node.children)
    		require.NoError(t, err)
    		nodes, separators, err := node.Split()
    		require.NoError(t, err)
    		for _, part := range nodes {
    			for _, key := range part.keys {
    				key[0] ^= 0xff
    			}
    			if len(part.keys) > 0 {
    				part.keys[0] = []byte("replacement")
    			}
    			part.children[0] = 999
    		}
    		for _, key := range separators {
    			key[0] ^= 0xff
    		}
    		assert.Equal(t, before, node)
    	}
    }
    
    func TestBPlusInternal_SplitRejectsInvalidNodes(t *testing.T) {
    	cases := []struct {
    		name string
    		node *BPlusInternal
    		want error
    	}{
    		{"Nil", nil, ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"NoChildren", &BPlusInternal{}, ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode},
    		{"MissingChild", &BPlusInternal{keys: byteStrings("a"), children: []uint64{1}}, ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode},
    		{"DuplicateChildren", &BPlusInternal{keys: byteStrings("a"), children: []uint64{1, 1}}, ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode},
    		{"ZeroChild", &BPlusInternal{children: []uint64{0}}, ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode},
    		{"ChildTooLarge", &BPlusInternal{children: []uint64{maxPageID + 1}}, ErrPagerInvalidInternalNode},
    		{"DescendingKeys", &BPlusInternal{keys: byteStrings("b", "a"), children: []uint64{1, 2, 3}}, ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"DuplicateKeys", &BPlusInternal{keys: byteStrings("a", "a"), children: []uint64{1, 2, 3}}, ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
    		{"OversizedKey", internalSplitFixture(t, []int{4076}), ErrPagerEntryTooLarge},
    		{"OversizedKeyAfterOverflow", internalSplitFixture(t, []int{3000, 3000, 4076}), ErrPagerEntryTooLarge},
    	}
    	for _, tc := range cases {
    		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
    			nodes, separators, err := tc.node.Split()
    			require.ErrorIs(t, err, tc.want)
    			assert.Nil(t, nodes)
    			assert.Nil(t, separators)
    		})
    	}
    }

    package database
    
    import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
    
        "github.com/Noah-Wilderom/godb/pkg/pager"
    )
    
    type nodeSplitPlan struct {
        pages      [][]byte
        separators [][]byte
    }
    
    type rootSplitPlan struct {
        leafPages  [][]byte
        rootPage   []byte
        headerPage []byte
        header     pager.DatabaseHeader
    }
    
    func prepareLeafSplit(leaf *pager.BPlusLeaf) (*nodeSplitPlan, error) {
        leaves, err := leaf.Split()
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        plan := &nodeSplitPlan{
            pages:      make([][]byte, len(leaves)),
            separators: make([][]byte, len(leaves)-1),
        }
    
        for idx, leaf := range leaves {
            page, err := pager.EncodeLeaf(leaf)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, err
            }
    
            plan.pages[idx] = page
    
            if idx > 0 {
                firstKey, hasFirstKey := leaf.FirstKey()
                if !hasFirstKey {
                    return nil, fmt.Errorf("leaf %d has no first key: %w", idx, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
                }
    
                plan.separators[idx-1] = firstKey
            }
        }
    
        return plan, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) prepareRootLeafSplit(leaf *pager.BPlusLeaf) (*rootSplitPlan, error) {
        plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("prepare leaf split: %w", err)
        }
    
        if len(plan.pages) < 2 {
            return nil, errors.New("there's no need to create a new root for a leaf that already fits")
        }
    
        n := uint64(len(plan.pages))
        nextHeader := *db.header
        nextHeader.RootPageID = db.header.PageCount + n - 1
        nextHeader.PageCount = db.header.PageCount + n
    
        headerBytes, err := pager.EncodeHeader(&nextHeader)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode new header: %w", err)
        }
    
        childPageIDS := make([]uint64, n)
        childPageIDS[0] = db.header.RootPageID
        for i := 1; i < len(childPageIDS); i++ {
            childPageIDS[i] = db.header.PageCount + uint64(i-1)
        }
    
        root, err := pager.NewBPlusInternal(plan.separators, childPageIDS)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("create new root: %w", err)
        }
    
        rootBytes, err := pager.EncodeInternal(root)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, fmt.Errorf("encode new root: %w", err)
        }
    
        return &rootSplitPlan{
            leafPages:  plan.pages,
            rootPage:   rootBytes,
            headerPage: headerBytes,
            header:     nextHeader,
        }, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) splitRootLeaf(leaf *pager.BPlusLeaf) error {
        plan, err := db.prepareRootLeafSplit(leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("prepare root leaf split: %w", err)
        }
    
        fileSize, err := db.pager.GetFileSize()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("get file size: %w", err)
        }
    
        if fileSize != db.header.PageCount*uint64(db.header.PageSize) {
            return fmt.Errorf("file size %d does not match header page count %d and page size %d: %w", fileSize, db.header.PageCount, db.header.PageSize, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
        }
    
        for i := 1; i < len(plan.leafPages); i++ {
            pageID, err := db.pager.AppendPage(plan.leafPages[i])
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("append leaf page %d: %w", i, err)
            }
    
            if pageID != db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1) {
                return fmt.Errorf("appended leaf page %d has unexpected page ID %d, expected %d: %w", i, pageID, db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1), pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
            }
        }
    
        rootPageID, err := db.pager.AppendPage(plan.rootPage)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("append root page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if rootPageID != plan.header.RootPageID {
            return fmt.Errorf("appended root page has unexpected page ID %d, expected %d: %w", rootPageID, plan.header.RootPageID, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(db.header.RootPageID, plan.leafPages[0]); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write first leaf page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(0, plan.headerPage); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write new header page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("flush pager: %w", err)
        }
    
        db.header = &plan.header
        return nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) prepareParentUpdate(location *leafLocation, plan *nodeSplitPlan) (uint64, []byte, error) {
        if len(location.parents) < 1 || len(plan.pages) < 2 {
            return 0, nil, errors.New("cannot prepare parent update for a leaf with no parents or a split plan with less than 2 pages")
        }
    
        parentID := location.parents[len(location.parents)-1]
        parentPage, err := db.pager.ReadPage(parentID)
        if err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("read parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        parent, err := pager.DecodeInternal(parentPage)
        if err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("decode parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        rightChildren := make([]uint64, len(plan.pages)-1)
        for i := range rightChildren {
            rightChildren[i] = db.header.PageCount + uint64(i)
        }
    
        if err := parent.InsertSplit(location.pageID, plan.separators, rightChildren); err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("insert split into parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        updatedParentPage, err := pager.EncodeInternal(parent)
        if err != nil {
            return 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("encode updated parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        return parentID, updatedParentPage, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) splitNonRootLeaf(location *leafLocation) error {
        plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("prepare leaf split: %w", err)
        }
    
        parentID, updatedParentPage, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("prepare parent update: %w", err)
        }
    
        nextHeader := *db.header
        nextHeader.PageCount += uint64(len(plan.pages) - 1)
    
        headerBytes, err := pager.EncodeHeader(&nextHeader)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("encode new header: %w", err)
        }
    
        fileSize, err := db.pager.GetFileSize()
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("get file size: %w", err)
        }
    
        if fileSize != db.header.PageCount*uint64(db.header.PageSize) {
            return fmt.Errorf("file size %d does not match header page count %d and page size %d: %w", fileSize, db.header.PageCount, db.header.PageSize, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
        }
    
        for i := 1; i < len(plan.pages); i++ {
            pageID, err := db.pager.AppendPage(plan.pages[i])
            if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("append leaf page %d: %w", i, err)
            }
    
            if pageID != db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1) {
                return fmt.Errorf("appended leaf page %d has unexpected page ID %d, expected %d: %w", i, pageID, db.header.PageCount+uint64(i-1), pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
            }
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(location.pageID, plan.pages[0]); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write first leaf page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(parentID, updatedParentPage); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write updated parent page %d: %w", parentID, err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.WritePage(0, headerBytes); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write new header page: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("flush pager: %w", err)
        }
    
        db.header = &nextHeader
        return nil
    }
    
    func prepareInternalSplit(node *pager.BPlusInternal) (*nodeSplitPlan, error) {
        internals, separators, err := node.Split()
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        pages := make([][]byte, len(internals))
    
        for idx, internal := range internals {
            page, err := pager.EncodeInternal(internal)
            if err != nil {
                return nil, err
            }
    
            pages[idx] = page
        }
    
        return &nodeSplitPlan{
            pages:      pages,
            separators: separators,
        }, nil
    }

2. Append `page` to `plan.appendedPages`.

```go
func (plan *treeSplitPlan) addSplit(
```

Its job is to:

    func (plan *treeSplitPlan) appendPage(page []byte) uint64 {
        pageID := plan.header.PageCount
    
        plan.appendedPages = append(plan.appendedPages, page)
    
        plan.header.PageCount++
        return pageID
    }
    
    func (plan *treeSplitPlan) addSplit(pageID uint64, split *nodeSplitPlan) []uint64 {
        plan.updates = append(plan.updates, pageUpdate{
            pageID: pageID,
            page:   split.pages[0],
        })
    
        rightChildren := make([]uint64, len(split.pages)-1)
    
```go
        for i, page := range split.pages[1:] {
            rightChildren[i] = plan.appendPage(page)
        }
```
    
        return rightChildren
    }

```go
pager.NewBPlusInternal(separators, children)
```

Handle its error, then try `pager.EncodeInternal` on the result.

```go
newSplitPlan.header.RootPageID = newSplitPlan.appendPage(rootPage)
return newSplitPlan, nil
```

**3. If encoding fails with anything except `ErrPagerPageFull`, return the error.**

**4. If the candidate root is full, split it and try another level.**

- Call `prepareInternalSplit` on the candidate.
- Allocate a new `children` slice with one entry per resulting page.
- For **every** resulting page, call `newSplitPlan.appendPage` and store its ID in `children`.
- Replace `separators` with the split’s promoted separators.

Use `appendPage` for every piece here. **This candidate is a new node with no existing page ID to reuse**, so `addSplit` doesn’t apply.

The process looks like:

```text
Pieces of the old root
          ↓
Try a new root above them
          ↓ too large
Split that candidate into new internal pages
          ↓
Try a new root above those pages
          ↓ fits
Save its page ID as RootPageID
```

Everything still happens in memory. Once this works, we’ll test the complete preparation before connecting it to disk writes.

    func parentUpdateFixture(t testing.TB, threeLeaves bool) (*Database, string, *leafLocation, *nodeSplitPlan) {
        t.Helper()
        db, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, 7, traversalPages(t))
        location, err := db.findLeaf([]byte("ant"))
        require.NoError(t, err)
        if threeLeaves {
            location.leaf.Put([]byte("ant"), make([]byte, 1993))
            location.leaf.Put([]byte("bat"), make([]byte, 2993))
            location.leaf.Put([]byte("bee"), make([]byte, 1993))
        } else {
            location.leaf.Put([]byte("ant"), make([]byte, 2000))
            location.leaf.Put([]byte("bee"), make([]byte, 2084))
        }
        plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        return db, path, location, plan
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_PreservesSiblingsAndSelectsImmediateParent(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name, first, second string
            parentID            uint64
            keys                []string
            children            []uint64
        }{
            {"LeftChildOfLeftParent", "ant", "bee", 5, []string{"bee", "cat"}, []uint64{1, 8, 2}},
            {"RightChildOfLeftParent", "cat", "catalog", 5, []string{"cat", "catalog"}, []uint64{1, 2, 8}},
            {"LeftChildOfRightParent", "dog", "fox", 6, []string{"fox", "yak"}, []uint64{3, 8, 4}},
            {"RightChildOfRightParent", "yak", "zebra", 6, []string{"yak", "zebra"}, []uint64{3, 4, 8}},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                db, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, 7, traversalPages(t))
                location, err := db.findLeaf([]byte(tc.first))
                require.NoError(t, err)
                location.leaf.Put([]byte(tc.first), make([]byte, 2000))
                location.leaf.Put([]byte(tc.second), make([]byte, 2084))
                plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(location.leaf)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                require.Len(t, plan.pages, 2)
                before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                headerBefore := *db.header
                pagesBefore := bytes.Join(plan.pages, nil)
                parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                assert.Equal(t, tc.parentID, parentID)
                assert.Equal(t, traversalInternalPage(t, tc.keys, tc.children), page)
                parent, err := pager.DecodeInternal(page)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                assert.Equal(t, location.pageID, parent.ChildFor([]byte(tc.first)))
                assert.Equal(t, uint64(8), parent.ChildFor([]byte(tc.second)))
                assert.Equal(t, []uint64{7, tc.parentID}, location.parents)
                assert.Equal(t, [][]byte{[]byte(tc.second)}, plan.separators)
                assert.Equal(t, pagesBefore, bytes.Join(plan.pages, nil))
                assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
                assertFileContents(t, path, before)
            })
        }
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_AddsMultipleChildren(t *testing.T) {
        db, path, location, plan := parentUpdateFixture(t, true)
        require.Len(t, plan.pages, 3)
        before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        assert.Equal(t, uint64(5), parentID)
        assert.Equal(t, traversalInternalPage(t, []string{"bat", "bee", "cat"}, []uint64{1, 8, 9, 2}), page)
        assert.Equal(t, uint64(8), db.header.PageCount)
        assertFileContents(t, path, before)
        page[0] = 0xff
        _, again, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        assert.Equal(t, byte(pager.PageTypeInternal), again[0])
        assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    }
    
    func TestPrepareParentUpdate_RejectsInvalidInputWithoutWriting(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name   string
            change func(*leafLocation, *nodeSplitPlan)
            want   error
        }{
            {"NoParent", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { l.parents = nil }, nil},
            {"NoPages", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { p.pages = nil }, nil},
            {"OnePage", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { p.pages = p.pages[:1] }, nil},
            {"MissingSeparators", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { p.separators = nil }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
            {"TooManySeparators", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { p.separators = append(p.separators, []byte("bob")) }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
            {"SeparatorOutsideChildRange", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { p.separators[0] = []byte("zebra") }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
            {"ChildNotInParent", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { l.pageID = 4 }, pager.ErrPagerInvalidArgument},
            {"ParentIsLeaf", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { l.parents = []uint64{7, 1} }, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage},
            {"MissingParentPage", func(l *leafLocation, p *nodeSplitPlan) { l.parents = []uint64{7, 8} }, io.EOF},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                db, path, location, plan := parentUpdateFixture(t, false)
                tc.change(location, plan)
                before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                headerBefore := *db.header
                parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
                require.Error(t, err)
                if tc.want != nil {
                    require.ErrorIs(t, err, tc.want)
                }
                assert.Zero(t, parentID)
                assert.Nil(t, page)
                assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
                assertFileContents(t, path, before)
            })
        }
    }

        require.Len(t, plan.pages, 2)

        require.NoError(t, err)
        headerBefore := *db.header
        parentID, page, err := db.prepareParentUpdate(location, plan)
        require.ErrorIs(t, err, pager.ErrPagerPageFull)
        assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "encode updated parent")
        assert.Zero(t, parentID)
        assert.Nil(t, page)
        assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
        assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    }

        require.ErrorIs(t, err, os.ErrClosed)

        assert.Nil(t, page)
        assertFileContents(t, path, before)

    package database
    
    import (
        "encoding/binary"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "os"
        "testing"
    
        "github.com/Noah-Wilderom/godb/pkg/pager"
        "github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
        "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
    )
    
    func traversalLeafPage(t testing.TB, keys ...string) []byte {
        t.Helper()
        keyBytes := make([][]byte, len(keys))
        values := make([][]byte, len(keys))
        for i, key := range keys {
            keyBytes[i] = []byte(key)
            values[i] = []byte("value:" + key)
        }
        leaf, err := pager.NewBPlusLeaf(keyBytes, values)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        page, err := pager.EncodeLeaf(leaf)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        return page
    }
    
    func traversalInternalPage(t testing.TB, keys []string, children []uint64) []byte {
        t.Helper()
        keyBytes := make([][]byte, len(keys))
        for i, key := range keys {
            keyBytes[i] = []byte(key)
        }
        node, err := pager.NewBPlusInternal(keyBytes, children)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        page, err := pager.EncodeInternal(node)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        return page
    }
    
    func traversalPages(t testing.TB) [][]byte {
        t.Helper()
        return [][]byte{
            traversalLeafPage(t, "ant", "bee"),
            traversalLeafPage(t, "cat", "catalog"),
            traversalLeafPage(t, "dog", "fox"),
            traversalLeafPage(t, "yak", "zebra"),
            traversalInternalPage(t, []string{"cat"}, []uint64{1, 2}),
            traversalInternalPage(t, []string{"yak"}, []uint64{3, 4}),
            traversalInternalPage(t, []string{"dog"}, []uint64{5, 6}),
        }
    }
    
    func newTraversalDatabase(t testing.TB, root uint64, pages [][]byte) (*Database, string) {
        t.Helper()
        header := pager.NewDatabaseHeader()
        header.RootPageID = root
        header.PageCount = uint64(len(pages) + 1)
        contents, err := pager.EncodeHeader(header)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        for _, page := range pages {
            require.Len(t, page, 4096)
            contents = append(contents, page...)
        }
        path := writeDatabaseFixture(t, contents)
        p, err := pager.OpenPager(path)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        db := &Database{pager: p, header: header}
        t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
        return db, path
    }
    
    func TestDatabase_OpenAndGetThroughInternalRoots(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name    string
            root    uint64
            pages   [][]byte
            present []string
            missing []string
        }{
            {"SingleChildRoot", 2, [][]byte{traversalLeafPage(t, "cat"), traversalInternalPage(t, nil, []uint64{1})}, []string{"cat"}, []string{"", "ant", "dog"}},
            {"ThreeLevels", 7, traversalPages(t), []string{"ant", "bee", "cat", "catalog", "dog", "fox", "yak", "zebra"}, []string{"", "car", "cow", "wolf", "zz"}},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                fixture, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, tc.root, tc.pages)
                require.NoError(t, fixture.Close())
                original, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                require.NoError(t, Validate(path))
                for pass := 0; pass < 2; pass++ {
                    db, err := Open(path)
                    require.NoError(t, err)
                    t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
                    for _, key := range tc.present {
                        value, found, err := db.Get([]byte(key))
                        require.NoError(t, err)
                        require.True(t, found, "key %q", key)
                        assert.Equal(t, []byte("value:"+key), value)
                    }
                    for _, key := range tc.missing {
                        value, found, err := db.Get([]byte(key))
                        require.NoError(t, err)
                        assert.False(t, found, "key %q", key)
                        assert.Nil(t, value)
                    }
                    value, found, err := db.Get(nil)
                    require.NoError(t, err)
                    assert.False(t, found)
                    assert.Nil(t, value)
                    require.NoError(t, db.Close())
                }
                assertFileContents(t, path, original)
            })
        }
    }
    
    func TestOpenAndValidate_RejectMalformedInternalRoot(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name   string
            mutate func([]byte)
        }{
            {"TooManyEntries", func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(p[1:3], 65535) }},
            {"OversizedKeyLength", func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(p[11:13], 65535) }},
            {"ZeroChild", func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(p[3:11], 0) }},
            {"DuplicateChildren", func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(p[16:24], 5) }},
            {"UnknownType", func(p []byte) { p[0] = 0xff }},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                pages := traversalPages(t)
                tc.mutate(pages[6])
                fixture, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, 7, pages)
                require.NoError(t, fixture.Close())
                require.ErrorIs(t, Validate(path), pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
                db, err := Open(path)
                if db != nil {
                    t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
                }
                require.ErrorIs(t, err, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
                assert.Nil(t, db)
            })
        }
    }
    
    func TestDatabase_GetPropagatesTraversalCorruption(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name   string
            pageID uint64
            mutate func([]byte)
        }{
            {"Cycle", 5, func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(p[3:11], 7) }},
            {"ChildOutsideDatabase", 5, func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(p[3:11], 8) }},
            {"UnknownChildType", 5, func(p []byte) { p[0] = 0xff }},
            {"MalformedLeaf", 1, func(p []byte) { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(p[1:3], 65535) }},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                pages := traversalPages(t)
                fixture, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, 7, pages)
                require.NoError(t, fixture.Close())
                db, err := Open(path)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                t.Cleanup(func() { assert.NoError(t, db.Close()) })
                page := pages[tc.pageID-1]
                tc.mutate(page)
                require.NoError(t, db.pager.WritePage(tc.pageID, page))
                value, found, err := db.Get([]byte("ant"))
                require.ErrorIs(t, err, pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage)
                assert.False(t, found)
                assert.Nil(t, value)
            })
        }
    }

        original, err := os.ReadFile(path)

    func TestPrepareRootLeafSplit_PlansPagesAndPreservesDatabase(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name              string
            root, count       uint64
            sizes             []int
            groups            []int
            children          []uint64
            newRoot, newCount uint64
        }{
            {"TwoLeaves", 1, 2, []int{2000, 2084}, []int{1, 1}, []uint64{1, 2}, 3, 4},
            {"ThreeLeaves", 1, 2, []int{1995, 2995, 1995}, []int{1, 1, 1}, []uint64{1, 2, 3}, 4, 5},
            {"RootAwayFromPageOne", 3, 5, []int{3000, 2000, 2000}, []int{1, 2}, []uint64{3, 5}, 6, 7},
            {"SeparatorAfterTwoEntries", 2, 4, []int{1000, 1000, 3000}, []int{2, 1}, []uint64{2, 4}, 5, 6},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                pages := make([][]byte, int(tc.count)-1)
                for i := range pages {
                    pages[i] = traversalLeafPage(t, "original")
                }
                db, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, tc.root, pages)
                before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                headerPointer := db.header
                headerBefore := *db.header
                leaf, entries := splitPlanFixture(t, tc.sizes)
                plan, err := db.prepareRootLeafSplit(leaf)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                require.NotNil(t, plan)
                require.Len(t, plan.leafPages, len(tc.groups))
                require.Len(t, plan.rootPage, 4096)
                require.Len(t, plan.headerPage, 4096)
                assert.Same(t, headerPointer, db.header)
                assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
                assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    
                expectedHeader := headerBefore
                expectedHeader.RootPageID = tc.newRoot
                expectedHeader.PageCount = tc.newCount
                assert.Equal(t, expectedHeader, plan.header)
                decodedHeader, err := pager.DecodeHeader(plan.headerPage)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                assert.Equal(t, expectedHeader, *decodedHeader)
                assert.Equal(t, tc.newRoot, binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(plan.headerPage[16:24]))
                assert.Equal(t, tc.newCount, binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(plan.headerPage[24:32]))
    
                expectedRoot := make([]byte, 4096)
                expectedRoot[0] = 2
                binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(expectedRoot[1:3], uint16(len(tc.groups)-1))
                binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(expectedRoot[3:11], tc.children[0])
                start, offset := 0, 11
                for i, count := range tc.groups {
                    assert.Equal(t, databaseBytesWithEntries(entries[start : start+count])[4096:], plan.leafPages[i])
                    if i > 0 {
                        copy(expectedRoot[offset:offset+3], []byte{1, 0, entries[start].key[0]})
                        binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(expectedRoot[offset+3:offset+11], tc.children[i])
                        offset += 11
                    }
                    start += count
                }
                assert.Equal(t, expectedRoot, plan.rootPage)
                root, err := pager.DecodeInternal(plan.rootPage)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                start = 0
                for i, count := range tc.groups {
                    for _, entry := range entries[start : start+count] {
                        assert.Equal(t, tc.children[i], root.ChildFor(entry.key))
                        value, _, found := leaf.Get(entry.key)
                        require.True(t, found)
                        assert.True(t, bytes.Equal(entry.value, value))
                    }
                    start += count
                }
                plan.header.RootPageID = 0
                assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
                assertFileContents(t, path, before)
            })
        }
    }

    func (db *Database) Put(key, value []byte) error {
        location, err := db.findLeaf(key)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("find leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        location.leaf.Put(key, value)
    
        updatedLeaf, err := pager.EncodeLeaf(location.leaf)
        if errors.Is(err, pager.ErrPagerPageFull) {
            if location.pageID == db.header.RootPageID {
                return db.splitRootLeaf(location.leaf)
            }
    
            return db.splitNonRootLeaf(location)
        }
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("encode updated leaf: %w", err)

        if err := db.pager.WritePage(location.pageID, updatedLeaf); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write updated leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        if err := db.pager.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("sync database: %w", err)
        }
    
        return nil
    }

    import (

    type Pager struct {
        file *os.File
    }
    
    func OpenPager(path string) (*Pager, error) {
        file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_RDWR, 0600)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        return &Pager{
            file: file,
        }, nil
    }
    
    func CreatePager(path string) (*Pager, error) {
        file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        return &Pager{
            file: file,
        }, nil
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) validatePageID(pageID uint64) error {
        if pageID > maxPageID {
            return fmt.Errorf("page ID %d exceeds the supported range", pageID)
        }
    
        return nil
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) Close() error {
        return p.file.Close()
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) Flush() error {
        return p.file.Sync()
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) ReadPage(pageID uint64) ([]byte, error) {
        if err := p.validatePageID(pageID); err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        offset := int64(pageID) * pagerByteSize
        buff := make([]byte, pagerByteSize)
    
        _, err := p.file.ReadAt(buff, offset)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        return buff, nil
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) WritePage(pageID uint64, page []byte) error {
        if err := p.validatePageID(pageID); err != nil {
            return err
        }
    
        if len(page) != pagerByteSize {
            return fmt.Errorf("page size is not %d bytes", pagerByteSize)
        }
    
        offset := int64(pageID) * pagerByteSize
    
        _, err := p.file.WriteAt(page, offset)
        if err != nil {
            return err
        }
    
        return nil
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) AppendPage(page []byte) (uint64, error) {
        if len(page) != pagerByteSize {
            return 0, fmt.Errorf("page size is not %d bytes", pagerByteSize)
        }
    
        size, err := p.GetFileSize()
        if err != nil {
            return 0, err
        }
    
        if size%pagerByteSize != 0 {
            return 0, fmt.Errorf("file size %d is not a multiple of page size %d", size, pagerByteSize)
        }
    
        pageID := size / pagerByteSize
    
        if err := p.WritePage(pageID, page); err != nil {
            return 0, err
        }
    
        return pageID, nil
    }
    
    func (p *Pager) GetFileSize() (uint64, error) {
        info, err := p.file.Stat()
        if err != nil {
            return 0, err
        }
    
        return uint64(info.Size()), nil
    }

```go
func (db *Database) applyTreeSplit(plan *treeSplitPlan) error
```

It will perform the writes your plan describes. Much of the logic already exists in `splitNonRootLeaf`.

Implement it in this order:

1. **Encode the planned header.**

   Call `pager.EncodeHeader(&plan.header)` and handle its error before writing anything. This also validates the final root ID and page count.

2. **Check the current file size.**

   Compare `db.pager.GetFileSize()` against:

   ```go
   db.header.PageCount * uint64(db.header.PageSize)
   ```

   Use the current header here—the file hasn’t grown yet. Return an error wrapping `pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage` if it differs.

3. **Append every page in `plan.appendedPages`.**

   Call `db.pager.AppendPage(page)`. For index `i`, the returned ID must equal:

   ```go
   db.header.PageCount + uint64(i)
   ```

   Notice there’s no `i-1`: this slice contains only new pages.

4. **Write every existing-page update.**

   Loop through `plan.updates`, passing each update’s `pageID` and `page` to `db.pager.WritePage`.

5. **Write the encoded header to page `0`.**

6. **Flush the pager.**

7. **Only after a successful flush, update the live header:**

   ```go
   db.header = &plan.header
   return nil
   ```

Handle every error immediately, with context indicating which operation failed.

Implement this method first; we’ll review it before connecting it to `Put`. This write ordering follows our current design, but crash recovery remains a later milestone.

        }
    
        return nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) Get(key []byte) ([]byte, bool, error) {
        location, err := db.findLeaf(key)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("find leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        value, _, found := location.leaf.Get(key)
        return value, found, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) Close() error {

    package database
    
    import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "strings"
    
        "github.com/Noah-Wilderom/godb/pkg/pager"
    )
    
    type Database struct {
        pager  *pager.Pager
        header *pager.DatabaseHeader
    }
    
    type leafLocation struct {
        pageID  uint64
        leaf    *pager.BPlusLeaf
        parents []uint64
    }
    
    func Create(path string) (err error) {
        if path == "" {
            return errors.New("database path must not be empty")
        }
    
        if !strings.HasSuffix(".db", path) {
            path += ".db"
        }
    
        header := pager.NewDatabaseHeader()
        headerPage, err := pager.EncodeHeader(header)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("encode database header: %w", err)
        }
    
        leaf, err := pager.NewBPlusLeaf(nil, nil)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("create root leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        leafPage, err := pager.EncodeLeaf(leaf)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("encode root leaf: %w", err)
        }
    
        file, err := pager.CreatePager(path)
        if err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("create database: %w", err)
        }
        defer func() {
            if closeErr := file.Close(); closeErr != nil {
                err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("close database: %w", closeErr))
            }
        }()
    
        if err := file.WritePage(0, headerPage); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write database header: %w", err)
        }
        if err := file.WritePage(header.RootPageID, leafPage); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("write root leaf: %w", err)
        }
        if err := file.Flush(); err != nil {
            return fmt.Errorf("sync database: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
    }
    
    func Open(path string) (*Database, error) {
        if path == "" {
            return nil, errors.New("database path must not be empty")
        }
    
        p, err := pager.OpenPager(path)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
    
        header, err := inspect(p)
        if err != nil {
            return nil, errors.Join(err, p.Close())
        }
    
        return &Database{
            pager:  p,
            header: header,
        }, nil
    }
    
    func (db *Database) Put(key, value []byte) error {

    	"testing"
    
    	"github.com/Noah-Wilderom/godb/pkg/pager"
    	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
    	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

    func TestDatabase_PutPersistsTreeSplits(t *testing.T) {
    	for _, name := range treeSplitCases() {
    		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
    			fixture := newTreeSplitFixture(t, name)
    			expected, err := os.ReadFile(fixture.path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			for _, update := range fixture.want.updates {
    				copy(expected[update.pageID*4096:], update.page)
    			}
    			for _, page := range fixture.want.appendedPages {
    				expected = append(expected, page...)
    			}
    			headerPage, err := pager.EncodeHeader(&fixture.want.header)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			copy(expected, headerPage)
    
    			require.NoError(t, fixture.db.Put(fixture.insert.key, fixture.insert.value))
    			assert.Equal(t, fixture.want.header, *fixture.db.header)
    			assertFileContents(t, fixture.path, expected)
    			require.NoError(t, fixture.db.Close())
    			require.NoError(t, Validate(fixture.path))
    			reopened, err := Open(fixture.path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			t.Cleanup(func() { _ = reopened.Close() })
    			for i, entry := range fixture.entries {
    				value, found, err := reopened.Get(entry.key)
    				require.NoError(t, err)
    				require.True(t, found, "entry %d", i)
    				assert.True(t, bytes.Equal(entry.value, value), "entry %d", i)
    			}
    			require.NoError(t, reopened.Put(fixture.insert.key, []byte("updated")))
    			assert.Equal(t, fixture.want.header, *reopened.header)
    			require.NoError(t, reopened.Close())
    			again, err := Open(fixture.path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			t.Cleanup(func() { _ = again.Close() })
    			value, found, err := again.Get(fixture.insert.key)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			require.True(t, found)
    			assert.Equal(t, []byte("updated"), value)
    		})
    	}
    }
    
    func TestDatabase_PutRepeatedInternalSplits(t *testing.T) {
    	for _, order := range []string{"Ascending", "Descending", "Mixed"} {
    		t.Run(order, func(t *testing.T) {
    			path := writeDatabaseFixture(t, validDatabaseBytes())
    			db, err := Open(path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
    			entries := make([]testEntry, 80)
    			for i := range entries {
    				key := append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%04d", i)), bytes.Repeat([]byte{'k'}, 996)...)
    				entries[i] = testEntry{key: key, value: bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte(i)}, 1000)}
    			}
    			inserted := make([]bool, len(entries))
    			for i := range entries {
    				index := i
    				if order == "Descending" {
    					index = len(entries) - 1 - i
    				} else if order == "Mixed" {
    					index = i * 37 % len(entries)
    				}
    				entry := entries[index]
    				require.NoError(t, db.Put(entry.key, entry.value))
    				inserted[index] = true
    				if (i+1)%10 == 0 {
    					require.NoError(t, db.Close())
    					db, err = Open(path)
    					require.NoError(t, err)
    					for j, present := range inserted {
    						if !present {
    							continue
    						}
    						value, found, err := db.Get(entries[j].key)
    						require.NoError(t, err)
    						require.True(t, found, "entry %d after insert %d", j, i)
    						require.Equal(t, entries[j].value, value)
    					}
    				}
    			}
    			location, err := db.findLeaf(entries[0].key)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			assert.GreaterOrEqual(t, len(location.parents), 2, "must exercise internal splits")
    			require.NoError(t, Validate(path))
    		})
    	}
    }
    
    func TestApplyTreeSplit_RejectsPrewriteFailures(t *testing.T) {
    	for _, name := range []string{"InvalidRoot", "InvalidPageSize", "PartialExtraPage", "ExtraPage", "ClosedPager"} {
    		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
    			fixture := newTreeSplitFixture(t, "CascadeToNewRoot")
    			plan, err := fixture.db.prepareTreeSplit(fixture.location)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			headerBefore := *fixture.db.header
    			var want error
    			switch name {
    			case "InvalidRoot":
    				plan.header.RootPageID = plan.header.PageCount
    			case "InvalidPageSize":
    				plan.header.PageSize = 1
    			case "PartialExtraPage":
    				require.NoError(t, os.Truncate(fixture.path, int64(headerBefore.PageCount*4096)+1))
    				want = pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage
    			case "ExtraPage":
    				require.NoError(t, os.Truncate(fixture.path, int64(headerBefore.PageCount*4096)+4096))
    				want = pager.ErrPagerCorruptPage
    			case "ClosedPager":
    				require.NoError(t, fixture.db.Close())
    				want = os.ErrClosed
    			}
    			before, err := os.ReadFile(fixture.path)
    			require.NoError(t, err)
    			err = fixture.db.applyTreeSplit(plan)
    			require.Error(t, err)
    			if want != nil {
    				require.ErrorIs(t, err, want)
    			}
    			assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *fixture.db.header)
    			assertFileContents(t, fixture.path, before)
    		})
    	}
    }

    func TestPrepareRootLeafSplit_PlansPagesAndPreservesDatabase(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name              string
            root, count       uint64
            sizes             []int
            groups            []int
            children          []uint64
            newRoot, newCount uint64
        }{
            {"TwoLeaves", 1, 2, []int{2000, 2084}, []int{1, 1}, []uint64{1, 2}, 3, 4},
            {"ThreeLeaves", 1, 2, []int{1995, 2995, 1995}, []int{1, 1, 1}, []uint64{1, 2, 3}, 4, 5},
            {"RootAwayFromPageOne", 3, 5, []int{3000, 2000, 2000}, []int{1, 2}, []uint64{3, 5}, 6, 7},
            {"SeparatorAfterTwoEntries", 2, 4, []int{1000, 1000, 3000}, []int{2, 1}, []uint64{2, 4}, 5, 6},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                pages := make([][]byte, int(tc.count)-1)
                for i := range pages {
                    pages[i] = traversalLeafPage(t, "original")
                }
                db, path := newTraversalDatabase(t, tc.root, pages)
                before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                headerPointer := db.header
                headerBefore := *db.header
                leaf, entries := splitPlanFixture(t, tc.sizes)
                plan, err := db.prepareRootLeafSplit(leaf)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                require.NotNil(t, plan)
                require.Len(t, plan.leafPages, len(tc.groups))
                require.Len(t, plan.rootPage, 4096)
                require.Len(t, plan.headerPage, 4096)
                assert.Same(t, headerPointer, db.header)
                assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
                assertFileContents(t, path, before)
    
                expectedHeader := headerBefore
                expectedHeader.RootPageID = tc.newRoot
                expectedHeader.PageCount = tc.newCount
                assert.Equal(t, expectedHeader, plan.header)
                decodedHeader, err := pager.DecodeHeader(plan.headerPage)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                assert.Equal(t, expectedHeader, *decodedHeader)
                assert.Equal(t, tc.newRoot, binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(plan.headerPage[16:24]))
                assert.Equal(t, tc.newCount, binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(plan.headerPage[24:32]))
    
                expectedRoot := make([]byte, 4096)
                expectedRoot[0] = 2
                binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(expectedRoot[1:3], uint16(len(tc.groups)-1))
                binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(expectedRoot[3:11], tc.children[0])
                start, offset := 0, 11
                for i, count := range tc.groups {
                    assert.Equal(t, databaseBytesWithEntries(entries[start : start+count])[4096:], plan.leafPages[i])
                    if i > 0 {
                        copy(expectedRoot[offset:offset+3], []byte{1, 0, entries[start].key[0]})
                        binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(expectedRoot[offset+3:offset+11], tc.children[i])
                        offset += 11
                    }
                    start += count
                }
                assert.Equal(t, expectedRoot, plan.rootPage)
                root, err := pager.DecodeInternal(plan.rootPage)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                start = 0
                for i, count := range tc.groups {
                    for _, entry := range entries[start : start+count] {
                        assert.Equal(t, tc.children[i], root.ChildFor(entry.key))
                        value, _, found := leaf.Get(entry.key)
                        require.True(t, found)
                        assert.True(t, bytes.Equal(entry.value, value))
                    }
                    start += count
                }
                plan.header.RootPageID = 0
                assert.Equal(t, headerBefore, *db.header)
                assertFileContents(t, path, before)
            })
        }
    }

            want    error

        }{
            {"Nil", nil, nil, "prepare leaf split"},
            {"Empty", empty, nil, "already fits"},
            {"AlreadyFits", fitting, nil, "already fits"},
            {"ExactFit", exactFit, nil, "already fits"},
            {"OversizedEntry", oversized, pager.ErrPagerEntryTooLarge, "prepare leaf split"},
            {"ParentDoesNotFit", wideKeys, pager.ErrPagerPageFull, "encode new root"},

    }

    func splitPlanFixture(t testing.TB, sizes []int) (*pager.BPlusLeaf, []testEntry) {
        t.Helper()
        keys := make([][]byte, len(sizes))
        values := make([][]byte, len(sizes))
        entries := make([]testEntry, len(sizes))
        for i, size := range sizes {
            keys[i] = []byte{byte('a' + i)}
            values[i] = bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte(i + 1)}, size)
            entries[i] = testEntry{key: keys[i], value: values[i]}
        }
        leaf, err := pager.NewBPlusLeaf(keys, values)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        return leaf, entries
    }
    
    func TestPrepareLeafSplit_PagesAndSeparators(t *testing.T) {
        cases := []struct {
            name       string
            sizes      []int
            groups     []int
            separators []string
        }{
            {"Empty", nil, []int{0}, nil},
            {"AlreadyFits", []int{0, 2, 100}, []int{3}, nil},
            {"SingleExactFit", []int{4088}, []int{1}, nil},
            {"CombinedExactFit", []int{2000, 2083}, []int{2}, nil},
            {"OneByteOver", []int{2000, 2084}, []int{1, 1}, []string{"b"}},
            {"FullPageThenAnother", []int{4088, 0}, []int{1, 1}, []string{"b"}},
            {"TwoEntriesInRightPage", []int{3000, 2000, 2000}, []int{1, 2}, []string{"b"}},
            {"TwoEntriesInLeftPage", []int{1000, 1000, 3000}, []int{2, 1}, []string{"c"}},
            {"ThreePages", []int{1995, 2995, 1995}, []int{1, 1, 1}, []string{"b", "c"}},
        }
        for _, tc := range cases {
            t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
                leaf, entries := splitPlanFixture(t, tc.sizes)
                plan, err := prepareLeafSplit(leaf)
                require.NoError(t, err)
                require.NotNil(t, plan)
                require.Len(t, plan.pages, len(tc.groups))
                require.Len(t, plan.separators, len(tc.separators))
                for i, want := range tc.separators {
                    assert.Equal(t, []byte(want), plan.separators[i])
                }
                start := 0
                for i, count := range tc.groups {
                    expected := databaseBytesWithEntries(entries[start : start+count])[4096:]
                    assert.Equal(t, expected, plan.pages[i])
                    decoded, err := pager.DecodeLeaf(plan.pages[i])
                    require.NoError(t, err)
                    for j, entry := range entries {
                        got, _, found := decoded.Get(entry.key)
                        if j >= start && j < start+count {
                            require.True(t, found)
                            assert.True(t, bytes.Equal(entry.value, got))
                        } else {
                            assert.False(t, found)
                        }
                    }
                    start += count
                }
                assert.Equal(t, len(entries), start)
                for _, entry := range entries {
                    got, _, found := leaf.Get(entry.key)
                    require.True(t, found)
                    assert.True(t, bytes.Equal(entry.value, got))
                }
            })
        }
    }
    
    func TestPrepareLeafSplit_PreservesEmptyKeyAndValue(t *testing.T) {

        require.NoError(t, err)

        assert.Equal(t, databaseBytesWithEntries([]testEntry{{key: []byte("a"), value: nil}})[4096:], plan.pages[1])
    }

    func TestPrepareLeafSplit_OwnsPagesAndSeparators(t *testing.T) {

    func BenchmarkDatabase_PutNonRootSplitSynced(b *testing.B) {
        for _, valueSize := range []int{1200, 2993} {
            b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("InsertedValueBytes%d", valueSize), func(b *testing.B) {
                pages := traversalPages(b)
                pages[0] = databaseBytesWithEntries([]testEntry{rootSplitEntry("ant", 1993), rootSplitEntry("bee", 1993)})[4096:]
                db, path := newTraversalDatabase(b, 7, pages)
                initial, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                if err != nil {
                    b.Fatal(err)
                }
                header := *db.header
                entry := rootSplitEntry("bat", valueSize)
                wantCount := uint64(9)
                if valueSize == 2993 {
                    wantCount = 10
                }
                b.ReportAllocs()
                for b.Loop() {
                    b.StopTimer()
                    if err := os.WriteFile(path, initial, 0600); err != nil {
                        b.Fatal(err)
                    }
                    *db.header = header
                    b.StartTimer()
                    if err := db.Put(entry.key, entry.value); err != nil {
                        b.Fatal(err)
                    }
                    if db.header.RootPageID != 7 || db.header.PageCount != wantCount {
                        b.Fatal("unexpected non-root split metadata")
                    }
                }
            })
        }
    }
